compatible_hypotheses.when: high sensory experience weight + low immediate information burden
compatible_hypotheses.why: environment can carry desire before proof

compatible_hypotheses.prefer: BW-F02/BW-F06 with distributed proof and quiet boundary modules
compatible_hypotheses.why: customer needs inspectability rather than atmosphere alone

compatible_hypotheses.prefer: BW-F05 with intent-routed service and contextual CTA

compatible_hypotheses.why: human identity materially affects choice; feasibility determines realization, not family fit

prohibited_combinations.combination: Clinical Calm + decorative luxury media dominating condition/proof scenes
prohibited_combinations.reason: steals authority from evidence and can create false reassurance

prohibited_combinations.combination: Sensory Sanctuary + generic spa stock used as company reality
Guided Choice + repeated equal-card grid as the whole page
prohibited_combinations.reason: turns decision logic into obvious template signature

prohibited_combinations.combination: Human Craft/Local Human + unverifiable staff/premises/process claims
prohibited_combinations.reason: creative fit cannot authorize fabricated evidence

prohibited_combinations.combination: Editorial High-Consideration + Hero luxury followed by generic late-page FAQ/CTA
Proof-Led Process + feature inventory without customer task/risk framing
prohibited_combinations.reason: evidence volume is not persuasive causality

hard_separation.creative_fit: determines what art direction is appropriate
hard_separation.production_feasibility: determines how selected direction can be realized safely with available assets/evidence
hard_separation.rule: Production feasibility may cause adaptation/fallback inside the chosen creative logic; it must not silently select an inferior family.
